PhyloGNN Documentation
======================

PhyloGNN is a Python package for turning phylogenetic trees into PyTorch
Geometric graph data and training graph neural network models on those graphs.
It is intended for users who already have tree data and want a practical path
from tree input to graph conversion, feature engineering, training, metrics,
and reference lookup.

Fastest path
------------

1. Install the core package or the optional extra needed by your workflow.
2. Follow the quickstart to create a graph from a small Newick tree.
3. Use the graph data concept page to interpret `x`, `edge_index`, and
   metadata fields.
4. Move to the workflow guides for feature engineering, training, and optional
   tracking or tree file support.

.. Maintainers: add new user-facing task pages under user_guide/ and link them
   from user_guide/index.rst. Add shared concepts under concepts/, lookup pages
   under reference/, and recovery advice in troubleshooting.rst. Keep legacy
   docs/issues, docs/myprompt, and specs out of official toctrees unless the
   content is rewritten for ordinary users.
